lake_note: Nolin River Lake, KY - summer/normal pool elevation 515 ft, ~5,795 surface acres at summer pool (winter pool draws down to ~2,890 acres for flood storage). Coordinates below are anchored to verified public locations (USACE gauge, Kentucky State Parks GNIS record, and U.S. Census TIGER address geocoding) with nearby fishing-relevant sub-spots placed a short distance from each anchor. These are PLANNING approximations, not survey-grade positions - always confirm with your own GPS/chartplotter on the water.

spots.name: Dam / Tailwater Riprap
spots.notes: Deep water close to shore. Good cold-front and summer midday fallback - fish stack on the rock.

spots.name: Main Basin Point near Dam
spots.source: Approximate, offset from verified dam anchor
spots.notes: First big main-lake point above the dam - classic staging/summer ledge spot.

spots.name: Nolin Lake State Park Point
spots.source: Kentucky State Parks / Wikipedia GNIS coordinate (verified: 37 18 17 N, 86 12 49 W)
spots.notes: Park swim-beach point and boat ramp area; gentle taper into the main basin.

spots.name: Moutardier Marina Cove
spots.source: Co-located with Nolin Lake State Park (Moutardier Marina sits within the park)
spots.notes: Marina docks and boat slips - reliable shade/cover, especially early and late in the day.

spots.name: Dog Creek Arm
spots.source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER geocode of Dog Creek Rd boat ramp/campground (verified)
spots.notes: Shallow creek arm with a boat ramp and fishing pier - good spawning-season pocket.

spots.name: Dog Creek Channel Bend
spots.source: Approximate, offset from verified Dog Creek anchor toward the main channel
spots.notes: Where Dog Creek arm channels back into the main lake - a natural summer ledge.

spots.name: Wax Creek Arm
spots.source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER geocode of Wax Campground/Marina address (verified)
spots.notes: Upper-mid lake arm near Wax Marina - wide flats good for covering water in fall/spring.

spots.name: Wax Standing Timber
spots.source: Approximate, offset from verified Wax anchor
spots.notes: Flooded timber pockets off the Wax arm - classic largemouth ambush cover.
